name: Mike Laub
role: Founder and maintainer of the Idea Stock Exchange
about: I am building the Idea Stock Exchange: open-source infrastructure that ties the strength of conclusions to the strength of their evidence, so that the best argument wins regardless of which side made it. If you want to contribute, collaborate, or just argue about it, reach out on any of these platforms.
method: The pages here were drafted with AI tools (Claude, by Anthropic) working under my direction, and checked against the sources they cite. Every claim on them is open to argument like any other, and none of them is scored by who wrote it.
closing: All conversations on social media are public, which fits the ISE philosophy: reasoning should be visible, not hidden in private inboxes.
